exposure: maternal serum extracellular glutathione peroxidase (GPx-3) concentration
outcome: umbilical cord serum total Se concentration
umbilical cord serum extracellular glutathione peroxidase (GPx-3) concentration
umbilical cord serum selenoprotein P (SeP) concentration
umbilical cord serum GPx-3 enzyme activity
cohort: The study included eighty-three healthy mother-baby couples at the time of delivery.
finding: Total selenium, SeP, and GPx-3 concentrations were significantly higher in maternal serum than in umbilical cord serum, while SeAlb concentration was higher in babies, and cord serum GPx-3 activity correlated significantly with gestational age.
